questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Everyone feels that he is pompous, but I know the underlying truth that he is a man of
great understanding and love.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).

questions.questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the grammatically correct version of the following sentence.
He was youngest than his brother.
options: He was younger than his brother.
He was youngest to his brother.
He was too young than his brother.
He was young to his brother.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (A).

questions.questionText:

We were very much enthusiastic about our tour to Agra.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in active voice.
This was talked about in the meeting by the officers.
options: The officers were talking about in the meeting.
The officers talked about this in the meeting.
The officers in the meeting had talked about it.
The officers talk about this in the meeting.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the
given sentence.
From a recent research, evident is it that a lot more women have been opting for
professional courses.
options: it is evident that more a lot women
it is evidently that a lot more women
it is evident that a lot more women
it is evidence that a lot more women
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).
